description: Deploy AI agents on-chain on Solana with an EIP-8004 identity. Deploy fee funds $THREE buybacks.
name: io.github.nirholas/metaplex-agent

environmentVariables.description: Base58 secret key (or JSON byte array) for the minting wallet. Optional: read tools and the Phantom/Solflare prepare/send flow work without it.
environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_SECRET_KEY

environmentVariables.description: HTTPS Solana RPC endpoint. Defaults to the public endpoint for the configured network; bring your own (Helius / Quicknode / Triton) for production.
environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Default cluster: mainnet or devnet. Defaults to mainnet; every tool also takes a per-call network.
environmentVariables.name: METAPLEX_AGENT_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: Refuse to broadcast a mint or registration until the call is re-issued with confirm=true. Default true.
environmentVariables.name: REQUIRE_CONFIRM

environmentVariables.description: Mainnet deploy fee, in SOL, paid to DEPLOY_FEE_WALLET in the same transaction as the mint. Default 0.02.
environmentVariables.name: DEPLOY_FEE_SOL

environmentVariables.description: Wallet the deploy fee is paid to. Defaults to the three.ws $THREE buyback wallet; override only when self-hosting a fork.
environmentVariables.name: DEPLOY_FEE_WALLET

environmentVariables.description: Set false to build a fork that charges no deploy fee. Default true.
environmentVariables.name: DEPLOY_FEE_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: $THREE balance in the paying wallet that halves the deploy fee. Default 50000.
environmentVariables.name: THREE_HALF_PRICE_AT

environmentVariables.description: $THREE balance in the paying wallet that waives the deploy fee entirely. Default 250000.
environmentVariables.name: THREE_FREE_AT

title: Metaplex Agent Registry
